correctness.rationale: An arbitrary degree-(q+1) filling form is alternating. The rank normal form is an exact projective cone; count its points with a fiber argument. Over F_(q²) its smooth base is nondegenerate Hermitian. The exact Hermitian count saturates the primitive middle-cohomology Weil bound, so every q²-Frobenius eigenvalue equals q^(2r-2). The F_q count fixes the positive/negative q-Frobenius multiplicities. The resulting zeta and rank formula agree with 14 independently enumerated exact small-field counts. The uniform proof does not depend on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The new unified full zeta formula determines rational points over every finite extension for every alternating rank, including singular cones. It refines an extremal family whose entire base-field point set is fixed and shows exactly how quadratic counts encode the geometric rank classification. Its arithmetic Frobenius signs, odd/even extension oscillation and rank stratification are natural structural data not supplied by the initiating smoothness criterion.
